Spicy Sunday Road Ride

Palmer, AK · Road

Spicy Sunday Road Ride is a road group ride in Palmer, AK. It rolls monthly, on a Sunday at 3:00 pm from Backcountry Bike & Ski (start varies).

For visitors

Waivers are on file at the shop. Expect cold weather and rough pavement; 28 mm tires suggested.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 3:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 16 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It's a drop ride: if you can't hold the pace, you'll finish alone. Fine if you know your speed. Not a first ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Spicy Sunday Road Ride group ride

The shop's group ride for experienced road cyclists: 45 to 50 miles, about three hours, 16 mph or faster, and dropping back is allowed. The Sept 13 ride went out toward Sutton and King Mountain. The host moves it to Zwift once weather turns.
